name: machinaris
description: Building upon the official Chia binaries, Machinaris also offers a plot manager, log monitor, and a simple WebUI for Unraid.

paths.name: appdata
paths.description: Holds app data for the container. Not for temp plotting or final plot storage.

paths.name: plots1
paths.description: Holds completed Chia plots for farming.

paths.name: plotting
paths.description: Your fast temp space for plotting, ideally a cache pool or unassigned SSD.

ports.name: chia_protocol
ports.description: The TCP port for connecting to peers. Port forward at your router.

ports.name: farmer_port
ports.description: The TCP port allowing harvesters to connect with on your LAN. DO NOT port forward at your router.

variables.name: worker_address
variables.description: The IP address of your Unraid server on your LAN for controller/worker communication.

variables.name: mnemonic
variables.description: Path to the mnemonic key used by Chia to run.

variables.name: mode
variables.description: Determines which services Machinaris starts. Default is everything (aka fullnode).

variables.name: auto_plot
variables.description: When true, a Plotman plotting loop will be immediately launched on start of the container, applying your plotman.yaml settings.

variables.name: plots_dir
variables.description: A colon-separated list of all in-container folders holding your completed plots.

variables.name: blockchains
variables.description: The blockchain to farm. Leave set to 'chia'.

variables.name: blockchain_db_download
variables.description: On first launch, whether to download a fully synced copy of the blockchain database, avoidng hours/days of syncing. Off by default due to inherent risks. More at: https://github.com/guydavis/machinaris/wiki/Blockchains
